# Conake Browser v0.2.1

Open the shield beside the address bar and choose **Turn Off Site Shield for All Websites**. The toolbar shows **Off**. The setting applies immediately to all tabs, including new ones, and is saved in your encrypted local account. Choose **Turn On Site Shield for All Websites** to restore your site rules.

For a single blocked installer, open its entry in the shield menu and choose **Download This Link Once**. Conake saves it through the normal Downloads manager and keeps the source page open.

This update is for the Windows, macOS and Linux desktop apps.
